pages.title: Ancient YunLai Archery
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows$(br2)§lEffect: §r Draw time is reduced to about 0.5 seconds, arrow flight velocity and base damage are increased to 3.5×, and arrows leave an end rod trail.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Yunlai Archery and Ancient Cloud Bow Arts.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Loot Chests and Villager Trades only (Treasure; not available from the Enchanting Table)
